en: [[I]] [[could see]] [[the fireworks]] from the roof of my building and take pictures of them, hoping to capture the moment and [[to share]] it with my friends later.
me: from the roof of my building and take pictures of them
, hoping to capture the moment and to share it with my friends later
easy: from the roof of my building
hoping to capture the moment and to share it with my friends later
그 순간을 포착하고(capture) 나중에 친구들과 공유하기(share)를 바라면서.
요약: 옥상에서 불꽃놀이를 보고 사진도 찍으며, 그 순간을 친구들과 나누길 바랐다.
notes: and 앞뒤는 같은 모양: to capture(포착하다) and to share(공유하다) → 둘 다 to부정사
hoping(바라면서) 뒤에는 to + 동사원형이 와요. -ing(sharing)를 이어 쓰면 틀려요

en: After an important exam, [[Tim]] usually either [[gets]] [[some rest]] or goes downtown to meet his friends, a habit that he started three years ago when he entered high school.
me: or goes downtown to meet his friends, a habit that he started three years ago when he entered high school
easy: or goes downtown to meet his friends
a habit that he started three years ago
요약: Tim은 시험 후에 쉬거나 친구를 만나는데, 3년 전부터 생긴 습관이다.
notes: three years ago(3년 전)처럼 딱 정해진 과거 시점이 있으면 현재완료(has started) 대신 과거형 started
a habit that he started: 앞 명사 habit(습관)을 that절이 뒤에서 꾸며 줘요

en: [[The groups of workers]] [[accepted]] [[the new policy]], asked the company to change it, or refused it, and later informed their coworkers about the outcome.
me: , asked the company to change it, or refused it, and later informed their coworkers about the outcome
easy: asked the company to change it, or refused it
later informed their coworkers about the outcome
요약: 근로자들은 정책을 받아들이거나 바꿔 달라고 하거나 거부했고, 나중에 동료들에게 결과를 알렸다.
notes: and로 이어진 동사는 모양이 같아야 해요: accepted, asked, refused, informed (모두 과거형)
informing은 동사 역할을 못 해요 → inform(알리다)의 과거형 informed

en: [[Brown lines]] [[run]] along the backs of the amazing lizards and continue down their tails, making their skin pattern quite different from [[that of]] most other reptiles.
me: along the backs of the amazing lizards and continue down their tails, making their skin pattern quite different from that of most other reptiles
easy: along the backs of the amazing lizards
making their skin pattern quite different from that of most other reptiles
그들의 피부 무늬를 대부분의 다른 파충류의 것과 상당히 다르게 만들면서.
요약: 줄무늬가 등에서 꼬리까지 이어져 피부 무늬가 다른 파충류와 달라 보인다.
notes: that of ~ = ~의 그것: 앞에 나온 명사(their skin pattern, 피부 무늬)를 다시 말할 때, of가 따라오면 it이 아니라 that

en: [[A person]] usually [[makes]] [[a number of mistakes]] in life and learns lessons from them, becoming wiser and [[more experienced]] along the way.
me: in life and learns lessons from them, becoming wiser and more experienced along the way
easy: a number of mistakes in life
요약: 사람은 실수하며 배우고, 그 과정에서 더 현명해지고 경험도 쌓인다.
notes: and 앞뒤는 같은 품사: wiser(더 현명한)가 형용사이므로 뒤도 형용사 모양
experienced = 경험이 많은 (형용사처럼 쓰이는 과거분사). experiencing은 '경험하는'이라 어색해요

en: [[Some children]] do not [[speak]] often but express themselves clearly when they do, although they sometimes struggle to find the right words at first.
me: often but express themselves clearly when they do
, although they sometimes struggle to find the right words at first
easy: Some children do not speak often
but express themselves clearly when they do
하지만 말할 때는 자신을 분명히 표현한다.
although they sometimes struggle to find the right words at first
비록 처음에는 적절한 단어를 찾느라 종종 애쓰지만.
요약: 말은 적어도 할 때는 분명하게 하고, 단어 찾기가 힘들 때도 있다.
notes: 절(주어+동사)을 이끄는 건 접속사 although(비록 ~지만). despite(~에도 불구하고)는 전치사라 명사만 뒤에 와요
예: Despite the rain(비), we went(go 가다) out. / Although it rained, we went out.

en: Serene quickly [[turned]] on one foot in front of her friends but fell to the floor, and [[her friends]] [[laughed]] loudly at the surprising fall.
me: on one foot in front of her friends but fell to the floor, and her friends laughed loudly at the surprising fall
easy: quickly on one foot in front of her friends
and her friends laughed loudly at the surprising fall
친구들이 그 놀라운 넘어짐에 크게 웃었다.
요약: 한 발로 돌다 넘어졌고, 친구들이 크게 웃었다.
notes: 절마다 동사가 꼭 하나씩: and her friends ___ 에는 진짜 동사(laughed, laugh 웃다의 과거)가 필요해요
laughing은 '웃는/웃으면서'라 혼자서는 동사가 못 돼요 (was laughing이면 가능)

en: Cut unnecessary expenses, start saving, and [[track]] your progress every month if you want to achieve your financial goals more quickly.
me: , start saving, and track your progress every month if you want to achieve your financial goals more quickly
easy: start saving, and track your progress every month
저축을 시작하고 매달 진행 상황을 기록하라.
if you want to achieve your financial goals more quickly
재정 목표를 더 빨리 달성하고 싶다면.
요약: 지출을 줄이고 저축하고 기록하면 목표에 더 빨리 닿는다.
notes: 명령문은 동사원형으로 시작: Cut(줄이다), start(시작하다), track(기록하다)이 and로 나란히 → 모두 동사원형
if you want to ~: want to 뒤도 동사원형 achieve(달성하다)
